content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To get married in secret, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Sign the final marriage registry (5 minutes)
Step 2. Purchase discreet wedding bands (2 hours)
Step 3. Draft a confidential guest list of two witnesses (1 hour)
Step 4. Research legal requirements for a private ceremony (3 hours)
Step 5. Book a private room at the local courthouse (30 minutes)
Step 6. Select a quiet, secluded park for photos (1 hour)
Step 7. Confirm witness availability (20 minutes)
Step 8. Apply for a marriage license (1 hour)
Step 9. Order a simple bouquet from a florist (30 minutes)
Step 10. Pay the administrative marriage fees (15 minutes)
Step 11. Choose a date that won't raise suspicion (2 hours)
Step 12. Pick up the physical marriage license (45 minutes)
Step 13. Secure a neutral meeting location to discuss plans (1 hour)
Step 14. Arrange for a specialized wedding officiant (2 hours)
Step 15. Buy a simple white dress and a suit (4 hours)
Step 16. Have the wedding bands engraved (3 days)
Step 17. Pack a small getaway bag (45 minutes)
Step 18. Create a fake "weekend trip" cover story (2 hours)
Step 19. Request time off work for a "personal day" (10 minutes)
Step 20. Charge camera batteries for secret photos (2 hours)
Step 21. Get the dress and suit tailored (1 week)
Step 22. Withdraw cash for the officiant’s tip (10 minutes)
Step 23. Double-check all identification documents (30 minutes)
Step 24. Buy a basic tripod for self-taken photos (1 hour)
Step 25. Secure a rental car for the secret commute (1 hour)
Step 26. Write personal vows (4 hours)
Step 27. Find a jeweler for resizing (2 hours)
Step 28. Choose a restaurant for a private dinner (30 minutes)
Step 29. Map out the route to the courthouse (20 minutes)
Step 30. Make a dinner reservation for two (10 minutes)
Step 31. Contact the witnesses to swear them to secrecy (1 hour)
Step 32. Dry clean the wedding attire (2 days)
Step 33. Purchase a decorative marriage certificate folder (15 minutes)
Step 34. Practice setting up the tripod (15 minutes)
Step 35. Select the wedding music playlist (2 hours)
Step 36. Confirm the date with the officiant (15 minutes)
Step 37. Open a joint secret savings account (1 hour)
Step 38. Polish the wedding shoes (30 minutes)
Step 39. Pick up the flowers from the florist (20 minutes)
Step 40. Hire a discreet photographer (3 hours)
Step 41. Put the bouquet in a water vase (5 minutes)
Step 42. Confirm the ceremony time with the courthouse (10 minutes)
Step 43. Buy a bottle of celebratory champagne (30 minutes)
Step 44. Steam the wedding clothes (45 minutes)
Step 45. Write thank-you notes for the witnesses (1 hour)
Step 46. Look up local elopement packages (2 hours)
Step 47. Select a pair of comfortable walking shoes (15 minutes)
Step 48. Print the ceremony script for the officiant (10 minutes)
Step 49. Check the weather forecast for the big day (5 minutes)
Step 50. Arrange for a dog sitter under a false pretext (30 minutes)
Step 51. Buy a burner phone for secret coordination (1 hour)
Step 52. Fuel up the getaway car (15 minutes)
Step 53. Buy a small cake for two (45 minutes)
Step 54. Chill the champagne (3 hours)
Step 55. Prepare an emergency sewing kit (20 minutes)
Step 56. Hide the wedding rings in a safe place (10 minutes)
Step 57. Get a haircut and grooming (2 hours)
Step 58. Sign the preliminary license paperwork (30 minutes)
Step 59. Drive to the secret ceremony location (1 hour)
Step 60. Finalize the wording of the vows (1 hour)
Step 61. Coordinate the arrival time for witnesses (15 minutes)
Step 62. Pack a small mirror for touch-ups (5 minutes)
Step 63. Research the best lighting times for photos (1 hour)
Step 64. Create a checklist of all required items (1 hour)
Step 65. Exchange the rings and say the vows (20 minutes)
Step 66. Buy a small gift for the witnesses (1 hour)
Step 67. Have a final "cold feet" check-in (30 minutes)
Step 68. Take a celebratory "just married" photo (5 minutes)
Step 69. Arrive at the ceremony site early (15 minutes)
Step 70. Do a final mirror check of the outfits (10 minutes)
